text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with Smart Falcon finally begins.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A refreshing morning, perfectly suited for a fresh start.
Just as I was thinking of taking my time to get ready and head to the training track—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding-dong)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding-dong-ding-dong-ding-dong-ding-dooong!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Good morniiing☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now☆
That's not how it goes, is it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even running away with style☆
Everyone's favorite, Fal-co♪ is here!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Full-scale training starts today, right?
I was so excited, I just couldn't sit still☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"And so!
Let's go, Trainer♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As an umadol, there is only one destination to head for!
Naturally—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Good morniiing☆
A very good morning to you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The Umadol Live is about to start!
Make sure to recharge your energy☆
before heading out~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Brought along by Smart Falcon, we arrived at the riverbank.
It looks like she's going to hold her daily street live.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Umadol... What's that?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad you asked~~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
An umadol is the new definition of an idol!
Running in races and shining in live concerts!
It refers to sparkling umamusume☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Falco sings every day, aiming to become the top Umadol!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so~...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Come on over and watch, you two!
Front row dead center is wide open—"
Kyaa~~âª

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
!?
Wh-What's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey Vodka, go somewhere else!
A crowd's starting to gather, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hah!?
Why don't *you* go somewhere else!
I'm going to get coffee!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why are you acting all cool?
You can't even drink coffee!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
H-Huuuuhhhh～!?
I told you, I CAN drink it!
I said I can drink it black!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet-chan and
Vodka-chan are bickering again today!
So cute~♪

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
It's a real-life fight between Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet!
Let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
What?!
W-Wait a second—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Shock and despair☆
Falco's concert lost the venue fight...
choice_data_list: Those two are really popular, so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka are both promising contenders with high expectations for the Classics.
When I tried to console her by saying losing the spotlight couldn't be helped—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The Classics—the "Turf" GⅠ races...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
In that case,
I really can't afford to lose!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm doing it! The concert!
Even if no one's listening—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Believing it'll reach, I'll sing out loud!☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When we first met, she was performing a concert all alone.
Singing with all her might as if shouting "Look at me!", she was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It looked like it was sparkling brilliantly—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—*Sigh*~... In the end,
there were zero spectators today too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Honestly, it's frustrating.
But I'm not gonna let it get me down!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"In fact, Falco is totally fired up!
After all, adversity is an umadol's best friend!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I believe that the more walls Falco climbs over,
the brighter she'll be able to shine!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And besides! Considering Falco's dream, I can't be getting down in the dumps over something like this.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's right! First, we gotta turn dirt racing into the top tier of the world!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mainstream domestic races are almost all held on turf.
The Classic Triple Crown, Arima Kinen, Japan Cup, Tenno Sho...
Virtually all the most prestigious races are on turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, dirt races have plenty of fans who love their sheer power,
but their overall popularity falls a step behind.
As it stands, there are only two Central GⅠ dirt races.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—I know it's super tough
to become the top Umadol just on dirt,
surpassing everyone shining on the turf...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But, my mind's already made up!
Falco will run straight toward the top, looking only forward☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Together with Fan Number One... right?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Top Umadol on dirt’.
Having reaffirmed the dream we're striving for—"

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Is the concert over already?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hm? And you are...?

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, you were always singing songs, weren't you?
I was cheering for you the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text:
Since I had some free time today, 
I came to watch the concert! But is it over already?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...!
choice_data_list: We haven't done the encore yet.
We haven't done the encore yet, huh.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Yup, that's right☆
So it's not over yet♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll sing one more song!
—Straight from the heart, for you who came into my life☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the dream of an Umadol who might one day be called... legendary, began under the crisp blue sky!
